quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Shield your family’s well-being from the fleeting whims of emotion; prioritize steady, reflective guidance over impulsive reactions.
    • Foster an environment where rational love and compassion replace blind desires, nurturing children to trust their own inner wisdom.
  • Leadership
    • Lead by example by controlling the pull of personal ambition—let sound judgment and measured action be the true forces behind your decisions.
    • Cultivate a culture of self-awareness and temperance within your team, ensuring ambition does not derail collective purpose and ethical direction.
  • Product Management
    • In product development, ground your decisions in reason and the genuine needs of your users rather than the allure of transient trends.
    • Balance ambition with strategic insight, ensuring that every feature and innovation is driven by thoughtful purpose, not just the desire for rapid success.
